articles.title: Salesforce Agentforce Flaw Enables 0-Click Data Exfiltration via Prompt Injection
articles.summary:

articles.title: Sudo Vulnerability Lets Attackers Bypass Time-Based Authorization Controls
articles.summary:
A recently disclosed high-severity vulnerability in Sudo could allow local, unprivileged Linux users to manipulate time-based authorization restrictions in sudoers policies. Tracked as CVE-2026-96512, this vulnerability arises from how Sudo handles the attacker-controlled TZ environment variable when evaluating NOTBEFORE and NOTAFTER constraints.
